explanation: OS::Abort() is the platform-specific abort implementation that's called by fatal error handlers. It respects the global abort mode (g_abort_mode) to determine behavior: exit cleanly for fuzzing, crash immediately, or call abort(). IMMEDIATE_CRASH() generates a hardware trap sequence (int3/ud2 on x86, bkpt on ARM, etc.) for immediate termination without cleanup. Different platforms have different implementations (POSIX vs Windows) but share the same abort mode logic.
